title: How/where do you apply for mod?

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
You can make an application in the "Staff Applications" sub forum that is listed under Policy (https://avicus.net/forums/categories/1507), just click the new discussion button.

Also, when making your application, make sure to read these threads
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/85a2c3ea0 (Rules)
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/9b0090599 (Guidelines)
